sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Acid, Acid Spray, Circle Throw, Dragon Tail, Drum Beating, Fake Out, First Impression, and Rollout: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Normal-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Sheer Cold changes the field into Concert Venue 1 when the move does not miss.
Baby-Doll Eyes, Embargo, Play Nice, Quash, Slack Off, Throat Chop, Tickle, and Yawn change the field into Concert Venue 3.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Emergency Exit or Run Away: Speed +1 when it enters.
Heavy Metal, Punk Rock, Rock Head, Solid Rock, or Soundproof: Defense +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Progression
lines: Stage 4 of 4: the crowd grows through its stages and shrinks again.
Entering Pokémon with Klutz or Minus grow it.
Seeds grow it. Lowering accuracy or raising evasion shrinks it.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Synthetic Seed: Special Attack +1 and gains a special effect.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
